purpose: Measured audio artifacts for recorded-audio-spectral-analysis, quantization-dither-and-subband-allocation, and streaming-audio-resampling-and-subband-link.

raw.content: University of Iowa Musical Instrument Samples: oboe, fortissimo, chromatic notes C4 through B4 played consecutively; C4 occupies roughly the first 1.7 s.
CMU Arctic (speaker bdl) utterance a0001: clean studio speech, single US male speaker.
Open Speech Repository Harvard sentences, US English, 8 kHz phone-band; suitable low-level speech for the 3-bit quantization/dither study.
Beethoven, The Creatures of Prometheus Op. 43 No. 14, oboe solo passage; orchestral recording from Wikimedia Commons.

derived.content: 1.3 s sustained oboe C4 (fundamental ~261.6 Hz) for window/leakage/harmonic analysis.
12 s mono music excerpt at native 44.1 kHz: streaming-link source material.
The same excerpt resampled to 48 kHz by a declared method (ffmpeg swr default); the 44.1<->48 converter lesson should treat this as a reference, not ground truth.

notes: Speech spectrogram work should prefer arctic_a0001 (clean, 16 kHz); the OSR clip is already phone-band-limited and suits quantization exercises. License review is deferred; see provenance.json.
